About.metaDescription: The booking platform built for the Gulf's appointment-based businesses — bilingual, deposit-backed, no app to install.
About.title: Built for how the Gulf books
About.p1: Across the Gulf, consultants, teachers, coaches, and specialists run on appointments — and most of them run on chat. Bookings live in scattered WhatsApp threads, two clients land in the same slot, and no-shows quietly drain the day. The tool that once worked becomes the bottleneck as the practice grows.
About.p2: The software that exists was mostly built for other markets. It treats Arabic as an afterthought, ignores right-to-left layouts, or forces every customer to download yet another app — none of which fits how business actually works here: bilingual, relationship-driven, and built on trust.
About.p3: Mawedly is the answer to that gap: a booking platform that speaks Arabic and English natively, protects every session with a simple deposit, and keeps the direct WhatsApp connection clients already rely on. It's for the consultant, the teacher, the specialist, and every appointment-based expert who deserves better than a cluttered chat thread.
About.missionBody: To give every service business in the Gulf a booking experience that feels effortless — in their language, on their terms.

Faq.metaDescription: Answers about how booking, deposits, languages, and data work on Mawedly.
Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.subtitle: Everything you might want to know before you start.
Faq.q1: Does the customer need to create an account?
Faq.a1: No. Customers book directly from your link — they just pick a time, enter their name and phone number, and upload their transfer receipt. There's no app to install and no sign-up.
Faq.q2: How does the customer pay the deposit?
Faq.a2: The booking deposit is a manual bank transfer. The customer transfers the deposit straight to your bank account and uploads the receipt; you review it and confirm the booking. There's no payment gateway or card processing at the booking step — the deposit reaches you directly with no middleman.
Faq.a3: Yes. Each business only sees its own data, protected by row-level security. Bank QR codes and uploaded receipts are stored privately and are only accessible through secure, time-limited links.
Faq.a4: Completely. Mawedly is bilingual from the ground up — Arabic with full right-to-left layout and English left-to-right. Your customers choose their language, and you run your dashboard in yours.
Faq.q5: How does the customer get confirmation?
Faq.a5: After booking, the customer sees their appointment is pending. Once you review the deposit and confirm, they're notified — and an email confirmation can be sent automatically if they provided an email address.
Faq.q6: Can I use my own WhatsApp?
Faq.a6: Yes. Every booking includes a direct WhatsApp link to your number, so you can keep talking to customers exactly as you do today — Mawedly just removes the scheduling chaos.
Faq.q7: What kinds of businesses is it for?
Faq.a7: Any expert whose work runs on appointments: private tutors and coaches, business consultants, nutrition and mental-health specialists, lawyers, and consulting centres. If you book people into time slots, Mawedly fits.
Faq.q8: Do I need any technical skills to set it up?
Faq.a8: Not at all. Sign up with your email, add your services and working hours, and share your booking link. Most experts are live the same day.
Faq.q9: And how do I pay for the plan itself?
Faq.a9: Your monthly plan subscription (beyond the free tier) is handled securely by card through Lemon Squeezy, and you can cancel anytime. Note the distinction: the plan subscription is between you, the merchant, and Mawedly — while your customers' payments stay directly between you and the customer. Mawedly never touches your money.
Faq.a10: No. Mawedly is a scheduling tool only. You add your own payment instructions (account number, QR code, or any method) and the customer pays you directly — we never touch your money.
Faq.q11: Do I need a professional license to use Mawedly?
Faq.a11: Mawedly is a general tool for anyone. If your profession requires a license, you are responsible for ensuring your license is valid. Mawedly does not verify licenses.
Faq.q12: Where is my data stored and how do I delete it?
Faq.a12: Data is stored on secure servers via Supabase (see the Privacy Policy). You can delete your account and all your data anytime from the dashboard, or by emailing us at hello@mawedly.com.
Faq.q13: Is Mawedly responsible for service quality?
Faq.a13: No. Mawedly is a technical tool only, and the relationship between you and the customer is direct. Mawedly does not guarantee service quality or verify practitioners' qualifications.

Privacy.metaDescription: What data Mawedly collects, how it's used, and the third parties involved.
Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: Mawedly is a general online scheduling tool for creating booking links and managing appointments. This policy explains what we collect, why, and how we protect it. Mawedly complies with the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) of Saudi Arabia.
Privacy.collectBody: For service providers: name, email, phone number, business details, working hours, and optional payment info (account number/QR code). For customers booking: name, phone number, and optionally email. Customers may also upload a transfer receipt as proof of payment (optional), stored privately.
Privacy.useBody: We use your data solely to operate the scheduling service: creating and managing appointments, preventing conflicts, and sending booking notifications and reminders by email or WhatsApp. Analytics data (peak hours, appointment counts) is private to your account and is never shared with any third party. We do not handle your money — payment happens directly between you and the customer. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.
Privacy.thirdBody: We use Supabase for our database and secure cloud storage, Resend to deliver email notifications, WhatsApp (WhatsApp/Meta) to send booking notifications and reminders, and Lemon Squeezy to process your paid plan subscription (if you subscribe). Your customers' booking payments happen directly between you and the customer with no payment gateway. These providers process data only to deliver their service to us.
Privacy.storageBody: Data is stored on Supabase Cloud servers and may be transferred across borders for operational purposes. We apply appropriate safeguards (encryption in transit and data-processing agreements with our providers) to keep your data secure.
Privacy.securityBody: Encryption in transit (TLS/SSL). Full tenant isolation via row-level security (RLS): each provider accesses only their own data and never sees another provider's customers. QR codes, receipts, and license scans are kept in private storage and served only through secure, time-limited links.
Privacy.contactsBody: Your contacts (your customers) are stored in your account only — we do not access or sell them. When you delete your account, all contacts are permanently deleted within 30 days.
Privacy.rightsBody: You may access a copy of your data, correct it from the dashboard, delete it anytime via the dashboard or by emailing hello@mawedly.com, and unsubscribe from notifications whenever you wish.
Privacy.retentionBody: We retain your data while you use the service. After account deletion we permanently delete your personal data within 30 days, and transfer receipts within 90 days, keeping only an anonymous statistical record.
Privacy.cookiesBody: We use only essential cookies needed to run the site (such as your login session). We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.
Privacy.practitionerBody: For professions that require a license, a provider may enter their license number and issuing authority and upload a scan of it. License scans are kept in private storage and never shown publicly. This information is self-entered by the provider, and Mawedly does not verify the validity of any license — confirming the validity of a license and qualifications remains the customer's responsibility before booking.
Privacy.contactBody: For any privacy question or request, email us at hello@mawedly.com.

AcceptableUse.metaDescription: The rules for using Mawedly safely and lawfully, and prohibited practices.
AcceptableUse.title: Acceptable Use Policy
AcceptableUse.intro: This policy ensures Mawedly is used safely and lawfully, protecting the interests of all users and the security of the platform.
AcceptableUse.purposeBody: Mawedly is a tool for scheduling appointments and managing time. Use it for that original purpose, respecting your local laws and your customers' privacy.
AcceptableUse.doBody: Use Mawedly to schedule appointments and manage your time; keep your data accurate and up to date; respect your customers' privacy and don't share their data without permission; and comply with your local laws.
AcceptableUse.securityBody: You may not: attempt to hack or probe our systems for vulnerabilities; use bots or automated software to send excessive requests; attempt to access other users' data; or reverse-engineer or decompile the app.
AcceptableUse.contentBody: You may not post unlawful, fraudulent, or misleading content; racist, inciting, or abusive content; pornographic content (any child exploitation will be reported to the authorities immediately); or harassment or threats of violence.
AcceptableUse.sensitiveBody: Regulated professionals (such as doctors and lawyers) are welcome to schedule their appointments, but you may not enter or store the sensitive data itself inside the tool: clinical health data (such as medical records or diagnoses), confidential legal data (such as court evidence), or sensitive financial data (such as credit card numbers). Use Mawedly for appointments only, and keep sensitive records in a specialized system.
AcceptableUse.spamBody: You may not send spam or unsolicited promotional messages, or use customer data for marketing outside the platform without their permission.
AcceptableUse.commercialBody: You may not resell or rent your account, use the platform to build a competing product, or impersonate or pretend to be a Mawedly employee.
AcceptableUse.consequencesBody: We may suspend or terminate your account immediately and without prior notice if you violate this policy, and we may report the matter to the authorities if the violation is criminal.

Dpa.title: Data Processing Addendum
Dpa.intro: This addendum explains how Mawedly processes data on your behalf and each party's obligations.
Dpa.partiesBody: You (the user) are the data Controller. Mawedly is the data Processor, processing data on your behalf and per your instructions.
Dpa.natureBody: Mawedly is a technical scheduling tool. You control: what data you enter (your customers' names and appointments), its purpose (scheduling), and who accesses it. We process this data only to provide the scheduling service — nothing more.
Dpa.mawedlyBody: We process data only per your instructions; we do not sell it or use it for advertising; we notify you promptly if we discover a security breach affecting your data; we help you fulfil data-subject rights (access/correction/deletion); and we delete your data within 30 days of account deletion.
Dpa.yourBody: You are responsible for the accuracy and lawfulness of the data you enter, obtaining your customers' consent before collecting their data, and complying with data-protection laws in your country (PDPL, GDPR, CCPA, etc.). If your profession requires a license, you are responsible for its validity.
Dpa.subprocessorsBody: We use the following sub-processors. We may update the list and will notify you of material changes.
Dpa.transferBody: Data is stored on Supabase Cloud servers and may be transferred across borders for operational purposes, with appropriate safeguards (encryption and data-processing agreements).
Dpa.securityBody: Encryption in transit (TLS/SSL), tenant isolation via row-level security (RLS), and secure, time-limited file links.
Dpa.contactBody: For data requests or breach reports: hello@mawedly.com.
